problem: HR data is siloed in payroll, benefits, ATS and other systems with brittle integrations; Aragorn unifies it and adds agentic analysts.
product_category: HR data integration and analytics platform

founders.name: Ed Adjei
founders.background_notes: Reported to have built and overseen 700+ HR integrations.

founders.name: Gladys Adjei
founders.background_notes: Some outlets list her as CTO.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building and maintaining many third-party HR system integrations is laborious; founders had prior experience.

defensibility.rationale: Integration breadth and customer data connections create some lock-in.

market_need_then: Founders' prior role at YourCause exposed integration pain; press describes reliance on consultants and slow workflows.
outcome_analysis: Aragorn AI joined YC in Summer 2022 and raised a $4.3M seed in October 2025, about three years later, bringing reported total funding to roughly $5.5M. It remains a small active company; the slow timeline suggests capital-efficient but modest early traction.
notes: Total raised about $5.5M implies about $1.2M earlier funding not itemized. Businesswire fetch returned 403 (not bypassed); round details taken from search summary of Dallas Innovates.
